question: How do I approve a weekend leave request?
alternatives: exeat|weekend pass|can a boarder go home on the weekend|student wants to go home|sign out a boarder for the weekend
answer: Weekend leave is approved by the house parent on duty in [leave system]. Requests close Thursday at 5pm. Late requests need Head of Boarding approval.

question: What time do boarders need to be back from leave?
alternatives: return time|when do boarders come back on Sunday|sign back in after the weekend|curfew after leave
answer: Boarders sign back in by 6pm Sunday at the house office. If a boarder will be late, the parent should contact the house parent on duty before 5pm.

question: What happens if a boarder is late back from leave?
alternatives: late return|boarder hasn't come back|parent says they will be late|missed sign-in
answer: If a boarder isn't back by sign-in time and no message has been received, call the parent first, then notify the Head of Boarding. Record the late return in [leave system].

question: Can a boarder leave campus for an afternoon?
alternatives: day leave|go to the shops|town leave|go out for a few hours|afternoon out
answer: Day leave needs parent permission in [leave system] and approval from the house parent on duty. Boarders sign out and back in at the house office.

question: What time is lights out?
alternatives: bedtime|when do boarders go to bed|night routine|sleep time
answer: Lights out is 9pm for Years 7 to 9, 9:30pm for Years 10 and 11, and 10pm for Year 12.

question: When is prep?
alternatives: study time|homework session|evening study|quiet time for homework
answer: Prep runs Monday to Thursday, 7pm to 8:30pm, in house study rooms. Year 12 may study in the library with approval.

question: When do devices get handed in at night?
alternatives: phone hand-in|collect phones|device curfew|screen time at night|take phones off boarders
answer: Phones and laptops are handed in 30 minutes before lights out and stored in the house office. Year 12 may keep laptops for study with approval.

question: What is the morning routine on school days?
alternatives: wake up time|getting up|morning roll|before school
answer: Wake-up is 6:45am, breakfast roll is at 7:15am in the dining hall, and boarders leave for school by 8:15am with rooms tidied.

question: How does roll call work?
alternatives: attendance|check-in|head count|marking the roll
answer: Roll is marked in [boarding system] at breakfast, after school (4pm), dinner and before lights out. Report any unexplained absence to the house parent on duty straight away.

question: What are the dining hall meal times?
alternatives: breakfast time|when is dinner|lunch times|weekend brunch|what time is food
answer: Breakfast 7 to 8am, lunch during school breaks, dinner 5:30 to 6:30pm. Weekend brunch runs 9 to 10:30am.

question: How do I arrange a late meal for a boarder?
alternatives: missed dinner|keep a meal aside|boarder back late from sport and hungry|save dinner
answer: Email the dining hall manager by 3pm with the boarder's name and house. Late meals are kept in the servery fridge, labelled by house.

question: How do I update a boarder's dietary requirements?
alternatives: special diet|vegetarian|food requirements|meal changes|dietary needs
answer: Dietary requirements are set at enrolment. For changes, email the dining hall manager with the boarder's name, house and the change.

question: A boarder is homesick. What should I do?
alternatives: boarder misses home|kid wants to go home|upset and missing family|lonely|sad and wants their parents
answer: Homesickness is common, especially in the first term. Check in privately, keep them involved in house activities, and let the house parent know. If it continues beyond a week or two, refer to the Head of Boarding.

question: Two boarders have had a falling out. How should I handle it?
alternatives: argument|fight between boarders|conflict in the dorm|roommate problems|boarders not getting along
answer: Separate them calmly, hear each side privately, and inform the house parent. Log it in [boarding system] before the end of your shift.

question: A boarder says they feel unwell. Where do they go?
alternatives: sick|ill|not feeling well|health centre|nurse
answer: During school hours, send them to the health centre. After hours, contact the nurse on call through the house office.

question: How do I report something broken in a boarding house?
alternatives: maintenance request|broken window|leaking tap|fix a door|something needs repairing
answer: Log a maintenance request in [maintenance system]. For urgent safety issues such as water leaks or electrical faults, also call the maintenance on-call number.

question: What do I do if the power or water goes out?
alternatives: blackout|no hot water|power outage|water off|lights not working
answer: Check whether other houses are affected, then call the maintenance on-call number and let the house parent on duty know.

question: How do I get a key or access card for a boarding house?
alternatives: keys|swipe card|door access|locked out of the building|new staff access
answer: Request keys and access cards through the business office. Allow two working days. Lost cards must be reported the same day.

question: A boarder's laptop won't connect to the Wi-Fi. What should I do?
alternatives: internet not working|no wifi|laptop offline|network problem|can't get online
answer: Ask the boarder to restart the laptop and reconnect to the school network. If it still fails, they can visit the IT help desk during school hours.

question: A boarder forgot their password. How do they reset it?
alternatives: password reset|can't log in|locked out of account|forgot login
answer: Boarders can reset their password using [self-service password reset]. If that doesn't work, they can visit the IT help desk during school hours.

question: How can boarders print after hours?
alternatives: printing|printer|print homework at night|print an assignment
answer: Boarders can print to the house study room printer and release jobs with their student card. Report printer faults to the IT help desk.

question: A boarder's device is broken or damaged. What now?
alternatives: cracked screen|laptop broken|device repair|dropped laptop|won't turn on
answer: Bring the device to the IT help desk the next school day. A loan device may be available while it's repaired.

question: How do I book the boarding minibus?
alternatives: vehicle booking|book the van|transport for an outing|car booking
answer: Book through [vehicle booking system] at least 48 hours ahead. Drivers need a current school driver authorisation.

question: How are airport transfers arranged at the end of term?
alternatives: airport|flights home|end of term travel|coach to the airport|travel home
answer: Parents submit travel details in [leave system] by week 8. Transfers leave from the boarding precinct on the last day of term.

question: Can parents visit boarders during the week?
alternatives: visitor sign-in|family visiting|parents coming to the house|guests
answer: Yes, between 4 and 6pm on weekdays. Visitors sign in at the house office and must not enter dormitory areas.

question: How do I contact a boarder's parents?
alternatives: phone parents|parent contact details|call home|ring mum or dad
answer: Parent contact details are in [student system]. Note any significant contact in [boarding system].

question: When is laundry collected?
alternatives: washing|laundry day|clothes cleaning|uniform washing|dirty clothes
answer: Laundry bags are collected Monday and Thursday mornings and returned the next day. Items must be name-labelled.

question: What do I do with lost property?
alternatives: lost item|found something|missing belongings|lost clothes|lost phone
answer: Hand found items to the house office. Unlabelled items are kept for a term, then donated.

question: How do boarders sign up for weekend activities?
alternatives: weekend outings|activities sign up|Saturday trip|things to do on the weekend
answer: Activities are posted on the boarding noticeboard by Wednesday. Boarders sign up with the activities coordinator by Thursday.

question: How do I swap a duty shift?
alternatives: roster swap|change my duty|cover a shift|duty roster|can't make my shift
answer: Arrange a swap with another staff member, then email the Head of Boarding so the roster can be updated.

question: Where do I log a minor incident?
alternatives: incident report|record an incident|log behaviour|write up a boarder
answer: Log minor incidents in [boarding system] before the end of your shift. Serious matters must be reported to the house parent immediately.
